verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an infrastructure control-plane framework, and a product of this kind could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only says Crossplane exposes declarative APIs that external AI agents can act on. That is an adjacent capability for outside consumers, not a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
